newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Moody's says two Australia states can improve.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Moody's says two Australia states can improve.

text.p: Moody's Investors Service said on Tuesday the Australian state of Victoria's domestic currency AA-1 rating has scope for improvement.

There was also scope for an upgrade to South Australia's AA-2 domestic currency rating, but any change to the two states' ratings was not imminent, David Larson, of Moody's sovereign rating group, told a media briefing.
"It's clear that there is a likelihood at some stage in the future, but it's not necessarily imminent, that Victoria's rating which is presently AA-1 has scope for improvement," Larson said.
"And I would say the same for South Australia. They have taken an altogether more measured approach to adjustments," he said.
"We certainly see evidence of improvement in South Australia and if that persists it will obviously at some point be reflected in the rating."
"In the case of Tasmania, I think it is fair to say we regard that as well positioned and a stable rating," Larson said.
Tasmania has a domestic currency rating of AA-2.
